sections.heading: New August Titles
paragraphs: According to consolewars, the PlayStation Plus game catalog includes new titles for August 2026. PLAY3.DE reports that games for the PS Plus Extra and Premium tiers have been unlocked for the month of August.

sections.heading: RPG Highlights
paragraphs: PLAY3.DE notes that among the newly unlocked games, there is a specific highlight for fans of the RPG genre.

sections.heading: Helldivers 2 Update
paragraphs: ComputerBase reports that a new update for Helldivers 2 has caused player numbers to rise significantly.
